preconditions.expression: n == len(a) and all(0 <= x <= 2 * 10**5 for x in a)
preconditions.description: Input consists of an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2e5) followed by exactly n integers a_i (0 ≤ a_i ≤ 2e5).

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (stdout.startswith('YES') and len(set(a)) == len(inc + dec) and all(x in inc + dec for x in a) and all(inc[i] < inc[i+1] for i in range(len(inc)-1)) and all(dec[i] > dec[i+1] for i in range(len(dec)-1)))
postconditions.description: If a valid split exists, output 'YES' followed by two sequences: a strictly increasing sequence (inc) and a strictly decreasing sequence (dec), such that their union is a permutation of the input sequence a. If no valid split exists, output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES') == (len(set(a)) == len(inc + dec) and all(x in inc + dec for x in a))
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if and only if the input sequence can be partitioned into a strictly increasing sequence (inc) and a strictly decreasing sequence (dec) with no overlapping elements (except for possible duplicates in the original sequence, which must be assigned to exactly one of the sequences).
